title: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:
summary: Restlessness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Restlessness becomes more truthful when siree Raag, Third Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Restlessness steadies when he Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
